output.reason: [ev-53f0754c524f] and the linked PR title [ev-b0161bea2a27] say this is a dependency update: Flux moves to the Kubernetes v1.34.0 libraries and Go 1.25.0. The PR's changed files [ev-533f6169a3a7] are go.mod/go.sum, the Dockerfile, the Makefile, CI workflows and tests, so it is a change to what Flux is built with, not to an API, flag or setting. That is concrete enough to write the change as a dependency version bump to these versions, with no environment condition beyond running Flux 2.7.0. The earlier bump to Kubernetes 1.33.2 [ev-e6f81a6968bd] and the new minimum supported Kubernetes version [ev-25015016b295] are separate items in the same section. The evidence does not give the previous versions, and it does not say outright that operators are unaffected; that comes from the absence of any stated effect, so confidence is low.
